title: Bundle, Clone, Fetch, Push
summary: Move repository state between local installations using pack-preserving bundles and Git-like local exchange workflows.
whySQLiteFallsShort: SQLite can ship a database file, but it does not give you native bundle verification, prerequisite-aware apply, or local push/fetch workflows over immutable metadata objects.
SydraDB can exchange storage state as refs plus packed objects without inventing a second replication layer just for demos and ops.
Local clone, fetch, and push semantics let engineering teams rehearse multi-site workflows with the same primitives the storage layer already understands.
